 Slovak Coffee Map

A weekly-updated catalogue of coffees available on the Slovak market,
scraped from roaster websites, stored as JSON, and published via GitHub Pages.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Astro + custom layout (no Starlight)
- Data: Python scraper with crawl4ai + OpenRouter LLM
- Deployment: GitHub Actions + GitHub Pages

## Project Structure
- `data/products.yaml` - scraped coffee products
- `data/roasters.yaml` - roaster configuration
- `scraper/scrape.py` - main scraping script
- `src/` - Astro site source (components, pages, lib)
- `.github/workflows/` - CI/CD workflows

## Key Files
- `Architecture.md` - detailed system architecture
- `CLAUDE.md` - project documentation
- `Design.md` - brand and design system

## Development
- Scraper: uv run --directory scraper python scrape.py
- Site: pnpm dev

## Live Site
https://peterhadac.github.io/scm/
